 Print Filmmaker Rohit Shetty questioned Love Gill about her equation with fellow contestant Tanmay Singh, popularly known as ScoutOP, on Bigg Boss 20. Stepping in to host the show in Salman Khan ’s absence, Rohit pointed out that the duo’s physical closeness, including Scout massaging Love’s legs, hands and neck, could be interpreted differently by viewers outside the house. In a promo shared on the show’s official Instagram account, Rohit addressed Love’s bond with Scout and asked her to consider how their interactions appeared to outsiders. Love maintained that she viewed Scout as a brother, but Rohit disagreed with her assessment of how their closeness was coming across on screen. “When he’s massaging your legs, massaging your hands, massaging your neck. Love, that doesn’t look right. You tell Scout to massage your back. He’s massaging your calves. It’s not looking good at all,” Rohit said. Scout attempted to defend himself by pointing out that he behaved similarly with another contestant, Mahhi Vij. “I do, Mahi di too,” he said. However, Rohit clarified that he was talking about how their behaviour might be perceived by people watching the show from outside. “Scout! What you see outside, what you feel outside, that’s what I’m telling you. It’s looking absolutely wrong,” the filmmaker responded. The conversation brought the spotlight on Love and Scout’s equation inside the Bigg Boss house. While Love maintained that she considered Scout a brother, Rohit urged the contestants to be mindful of how their interactions could be viewed by the audience. His remarks highlighted the difference between how contestants understand their relationships inside the house and how viewers may interpret their behaviour on screen. Rohit, known for his action-packed films and the popular Cop Universe, stepped in for hosting duties while Salman Khan was occupied with prior commitments. His appearance brought a different hosting style to the reality show, with the filmmaker directly questioning the contestants about their conduct and relationships inside the house. The 20th edition of Bigg Boss began on September 6 and features a diverse lineup of celebrity contestants from television, music, social media and other fields. The contestants include MC Mary Kom, Kanika Mann, Mahhi Vij, Kushal Tanwar, popularly known as ScoutOP, Arishfa Khan, Qazi Touqeer, Asif Khan, Aamrapali Dubey, Uditi Singh, Rohed Khan, Yung DSA and Love Gill, among others. The Hindi-language reality show airs on Colors TV and is based on the Dutch format Big Brother. Over the years, it has become known for its mix of interpersonal conflicts, emotional revelations, tasks and unexpected alliances among contestants. Rohit Shetty is one of Hindi cinema’s prominent commercial filmmakers, known for combining action, comedy and large-scale entertainment. He gained widespread recognition with Golmaal, starring Ajay Devgn, Tusshar Kapoor and Arshad Warsi. The film’s success led to several sequels, including Golmaal Returns, Golmaal 3 and Golmaal Again.
